title: hieracium alatum subsp. cuneatum
intro: Hieracium alatum subsp. cuneatum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion-like species of the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium alatum subsp. cuneatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antihemorrhagic activities, which may help to alleviate symptoms such as pain, fever, and bleeding. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
